svg.title: stale-env
svg.desc: stale-env: a recorded terminal session, 16 s, looping. Steps: a shell that still exports an old souls folder / a new shell loads the installed values: claude invoke uses the installed souls

g.text: $ export MANDRAKE_SOULS=/old/souls; mandrake doctor 2>&1 | grep am
$ export MANDRAKE_SOULS=/old/souls; mandrake doctor 2>&1 | grep ambien
$ export MANDRAKE_SOULS=/old/souls; mandrake doctor 2>&1 | grep ambiente
FAIL ambiente: neste shell MANDRAKE_SOULS é /old/souls, o instalado é $TMPDIR//mandrake-cli.0KDnyw/mh/data/src
/data/prompt/souls · conserte com: abra um shell novo (exec $SHELL):
$ clear; new_shell claude invoke rhizo 2>&1 | cu
$ clear; new_shell claude invoke rhizo 2>&1 | cut -
$ clear; new_shell claude invoke rhizo 2>&1 | cut -c1-
$ clear; new_shell claude invoke rhizo 2>&1 | cut -c1-108
mandrake: proxy fora do ar em 127.0.0.1:64563, esta sessão vai direto para a API (mandrake doctor)

svg.text: a shell that still exports an old souls folder
a new shell loads the installed values: claude invoke uses the installed souls
